summary: This plugin adds a plugin-management interface for DeepSeek Harness, allowing users to list, install, enable/disable, and remove plugins through the web UI, CLI, or `/plugin` chat command while updating profile configuration.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Primary purpose is plugin lifecycle and runtime management for DeepSeek Harness: users can install, enable/disable, and uninstall plugins without hand-editing config through web settings, CLI, or chat command; evidence shows it rewrites managed sections of `cordis.patch.yml`, supports package installation via pnpm, and exposes `/plugin-manager/api`, so it is best classified as a plugin-management utility in the plugin-development category.
